## Balance Sheet

Set `asOfMonth`. `closes` queries every Month Close through it and `accounts` loads the chart. `rows` (`StatementRow`, an internal output shape) carries each asset, liability and equity account's balance on its normal side. `fiscalStart` is January of the as-of year.

Income has not been closed into equity, so equity adds two computed lines: `priorIncomeMinor` (income from closed months before the fiscal year) and `netIncomeMinor` (income this year). Totals: `assetsMinor`, `liabilitiesMinor`, `equityMinor`, and `balanced`, true when assets equal liabilities plus equity.

```ts
import { BalanceSheet } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-close';
```

### Non-goals
No operations and no comparative columns. The fiscal year always starts in January.

### Example
`Reports/balance-sheet-2026-03`, as of 31 March 2026.
